reason: Two independent verified occurrences share the behavior and boundary, so this is recurrence rather than an anecdote: several primary domains block direct fetch behind the agent proxy while search excerpts still return, so packets citing those pages carry excerpt-mediated quotes that read as deterministic reads. Method 3 covers an unavailable evidence service but not a reachable-but-blocked primary domain. The clause must be path-conditional, never an enumerated domain list, which would be false for environments without this proxy. Carries the residual deltas of the two records superseded into it.
